anti_tautology_rules: Fixture records contain no expected result field.
The checker imports no fixture index or expected-value oracle.
Test expectations are maintained outside fixture bytes.
Adversarial semantic mutations are rehashed where possible before evaluation.
Generated fixture bytes are compared against the digest-bound FIXTURE-CORPUS-ROOT.
Exact key-set enforcement prevents semantically active undeclared fields from surviving rehashing.
Canonical claim-bundle standing and source semantics are independently enforced by the checker.
The JSON Schema is descriptive; executable acceptance depends on the standard-library semantic checker.
Protocol notes, standing bases, and narrowing rationale are exact v0.1 semantics rather than unconstrained prose.
Top-level record integrity binds semantic state not covered by the predecessor event chain alone.
blocking_conditions: Any manifest or root receipt divergence.
Any authority, standing, endorsement, or evidence-reference inheritance bypass.
Any undeclared field accepted after internal rehashing.
Any invalid stage status accepted outside the fixed profile.
Any approval-bearing note, inherited-standing basis, or misleading narrowing rationale accepted after rehashing.
Any stale or absent whole-record integrity accepted.

review_corrections.observed_defect: The compact control plane referenced NO-EFFECTS.json and NEXT-STAGE-GATES.json after those surfaces were consolidated into GHCH-CONTROL-PLANE.json.
review_corrections.correction: Routes now target exact control-plane sections; the unit suite and candidate checker reject all pre-compaction route names.

review_corrections.observed_defect: Repository CI exercised semantic fixtures but did not directly invoke the candidate manifest/root-receipt checker.
review_corrections.correction: The unit suite imports and executes the candidate checker, making exact candidate binding part of full regression CI.

review_corrections.observed_defect: The descriptive JSON Schema was not executed and the semantic checker ignored undeclared fields and underconstrained canonical claim and status semantics; a fully rehashed record could carry hidden authority or standing data.
review_corrections.correction: The checker now enforces exact key sets at every object layer, fixed v0.1 canonical claim semantics, stage-specific statuses, exact protocol notes, exact standing bases, exact narrowing rationale, exact reference shapes, nonempty delta bases, and exact reconciliation/non-effect shapes. Six fully rehashed adversarial fixtures cover undeclared authority fields, canonical claim-standing promotion, invalid event status, approval-bearing notes, inherited-standing basis, and misleading narrowing rationale. The schema was aligned and explicitly remains descriptive.

review_corrections.observed_defect: The stale-route guard scanned all control-plane text and therefore rejected the historical correction record when it quoted the retired filenames.
review_corrections.correction: The guard now inspects only active README routes and claim-to-proof routing values, allowing historical defect evidence to remain visible while still rejecting operational stale routes.

review_corrections.observed_defect: After insertion of structural closure, the protocol headings jumped from section 4 to section 6 and two numbered procedural lists also contained gaps.
review_corrections.correction: All protocol headings and procedural lists were renumbered sequentially before exact-head review.

review_corrections.observed_defect: Canonical objects and events were digest-bound, but participants, profile, reconciliation, and declared non-effects lacked a self-contained whole-record digest outside the fixture file hash.
review_corrections.correction: A top-level record_integrity object now binds the complete cadence state. The checker and schema enforce it, refresh_record recomputes it after semantic mutations, and stale_record_integrity tests failure to update it.

review_corrections.observed_defect: The final evaluator and descriptive schema exceeded the connector's reliably verifiable one-shot object-transport boundary, creating a publication-integrity risk despite local conformance.
review_corrections.correction: The evaluator was separated into record, event-chain, and reconciliation modules; the immutable vocabulary remains in ghch_contract_v0_1.py; and the JSON Schema was compacted to a descriptive envelope that explicitly delegates normative semantics to the exact Python contract and evaluator. All valid/adversarial outcomes remained unchanged and the candidate was fully rebound before atomic publication.

review_corrections.observed_defect: The prior README duplicated substantial protocol prose and retained stale corpus counts after structural hardening, creating a second semantic source and publication-transport risk.
review_corrections.correction: README.md is now a compact orientation and review route. Normative vocabulary and key sets remain in ghch_contract_v0_1.py; invariants and gates remain in GHCH-CONTROL-PLANE.json; construction and review history remain in GHCH-QA-LINEAGE.json. The README states the current 20-case, 17-adversary coverage and does not duplicate the full normative contract.
